name: Sue Lines Pursuant to the order agreed on 23 June 2026, the time allotted for consideration of eight bills has expired. I'll now put the questions on the remaining stages of the bills. I will first deal with the Treasury Laws Amendment (Delivering an Efficient and Trusted Tax System) Bill 2026. I'll begin with the second reading amendment moved by Senator Hanson-Young. The question is that the amendment on sheet 3765 be agreed to.
